description: This file implements a server for remote firmware management and logging, including request handling, firmware reception, and process supervision.

classes.name: adsp_request_handler
classes.description: Handles incoming firmware download requests, receives firmware data, verifies MD5, and signals readiness.

classes.name: adsp_log_handler
classes.description: Handles logging output, monitors firmware readiness, and manages subprocess execution for firmware operations.

classes.name: device_runner
classes.description: Manages firmware file state, script execution, and synchronization for device operations.

classes.name: board_config
classes.description: Configures board-specific parameters, including load command and parameters.

methods.name: receive_fw
methods.description: Receives firmware data over socket, verifies MD5 checksum, and saves to file.

methods.name: do_download
methods.description: Coordinates firmware reception and signals readiness.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming command, initiates firmware download, and sends response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles logging commands, waits for firmware readiness, and manages subprocess output streaming.

methods.name: set_fw_ready
methods.description: Marks firmware as ready by placing filename into queue.

methods.name: is_fw_ready
methods.description: Checks if firmware is ready by retrieving filename from queue.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes firmware file and resets script state.

methods.name: get_script
methods.description: Constructs command script for firmware loading based on configuration.

methods.name: get_cmd
methods.description: Returns the load command for the board.

methods.name: get_params
methods.description: Returns parameters for the load command.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes board configuration with command and parameters.
